title: 多益核心單字
note: 音標、音節、重音由 tools/english-drill/phonetics.py 從 CMUdict 產生，不要手動填。這裡只要填 term / pos / zh / example_en / example_zh。

words.example_en: Please review the agenda before the meeting.
I forgot to include the attachment.
The deadline has been moved to Friday.
A memo was sent to all departments.
This file is strictly confidential.
Could you forward that email to me?
words.example_zh: 可以把那封信轉寄給我嗎？

words.example_en: We had to postpone the launch.
words.example_zh: 我們只好把發表會延期。

words.example_en: Send me a rough draft by noon.
We're running low on stationery.
Keep a duplicate for your records.
My workload has doubled this month.
words.example_zh: 我這個月的工作量翻倍了。

words.example_en: This request is urgent.
Who is taking the minutes today?
We expect about thirty attendees.
words.example_zh: 預計大約三十位與會者。

words.example_en: Her presentation was very clear.
Please take a handout from the table.
We need a bigger venue.
Could you summarize the main points?
Let me clarify what I meant.
words.example_zh: 讓我把我的意思講清楚。

words.example_en: Can we reschedule for next week?
We reached a consensus quickly.
The quarterly report is due tomorrow.
I'll brief the team this afternoon.
words.example_zh: 我下午跟團隊說明狀況。

words.example_zh: 我們的主要目標是控制成本。

words.example_en: We received over two hundred applicants.
words.example_zh: 我們收到兩百多位應徵者。

words.example_en: Attach your resume to the email.
She is the strongest candidate.

He got a promotion last month.

New hires have a three-month probation.
words.example_zh: 新進人員有三個月試用期。

words.example_en: We plan to recruit five engineers.
words.example_zh: 我們打算招五名工程師。

words.example_en: He meets every qualification.
She resigned without notice.
We're not paid for overtime.
Please send the invoice by Friday.
words.example_zh: 請在週五前寄出請款單。

words.example_en: Keep the receipt for reimbursement.
Travel expenses are covered.
That's outside our budget.
Reimbursement takes about two weeks.
Revenue grew by twelve percent.
words.example_zh: 營收成長了百分之十二。

You can request a full refund.
We pay in three installments.

Your payment is two weeks overdue.
They offered a ten percent discount.
We switched to a cheaper supplier.
words.example_zh: 我們換了比較便宜的供應商。

words.example_en: Could you send us a quotation?
words.example_zh: 可以給我們一份報價嗎？

words.example_en: We managed to negotiate a better price.
words.example_zh: 我們談到了更好的價格。

words.example_en: The contract expires in June.
We decided not to renew the contract.
The warranty covers two years.
Three vendors submitted bids.
The part must match the specification.
The manager has to approve the order.
Their bid was the lowest.
Read the cancellation clause carefully.
Compliance is checked every quarter.
We take inventory every month.
The goods are still in the warehouse.

Freight costs went up again.
Two units were defective.

Send it by courier, please.
The package is held at customs.
There's a two-day delay.
They are our distributor in Japan.
words.example_zh: 他們是我們在日本的經銷商。

I'll email you the itinerary.
I have a reservation under Ho.
We have a four-hour layover.
words.example_zh: 我們要轉機停留四小時。

words.example_en: Accommodation is arranged by the company.
The hotel shuttle runs every hour.
words.example_zh: 飯店接駁車每小時一班。

words.example_en: Check the departure board.

The campaign starts next month.

words.example_zh: 我們發問卷給所有客戶。

words.example_en: The feedback has been positive.
We received a complaint about delivery.
words.example_zh: 我們收到一件關於配送的客訴。

words.example_en: Your subscription expires today.
We launch the new model in May.
Our competitor cut prices.
words.example_zh: 我們的競爭對手降價了。

words.example_en: We put testimonials on the website.
words.example_zh: 我們把客戶好評放在網站上。

words.example_en: Most clients come from referrals.
The retail price is thirty dollars.
They opened a new outlet downtown.
words.example_zh: 他們在市中心開了新門市。
